title: Northgate Optical Prescription Range and Fitting Limits by Lens Design
content:
A Northgate Optical lens design is made only within its power range and only in frames tall enough for it, and only from a prescription young enough for it. The limits are:

| Lens design | Highest sphere power (absolute, diopters) | Highest cylinder power (absolute, diopters) | Highest add power (diopters) | Smallest frame fitting height (mm) | Oldest prescription accepted, by issue date (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 12.00 | 6.00 | 0.00 (single vision) | 0 (no minimum) | 24 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 10.00 | 4.00 | 3.50 | 18 | 24 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 8.00 | 4.00 | 3.50 | 22 | 24 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 10.00 | 4.00 | 3.50 | 16 | 24 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 12.00 | 6.00 | 3.50 | 15 | 24 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 14.00 | 6.00 | 3.50 | 14 | 12 |

## How the limits read

- Sphere and cylinder limits are on the absolute value of the power: a sphere of minus 9.50 and one of plus 9.50 are both within a 10.00 limit.
- An add power of 0.00 marks a single vision design; the multifocal designs are made up to an add of 3.50.
- The fitting height is a minimum: a frame whose fitting height is at least the figure shown can be cut for the design. A figure of 0 means the design has no minimum.
- The prescription age limit is counted in calendar months from the prescription's issue date.

## Illustrative fits (hypothetical prescriptions)

| Prescription and frame | Designs within limits |
|---|---|
| Sphere minus 11.00, cylinder 2.00, add 2.25, fitting height 20 mm | Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses and Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses (the sphere is above 10.00, ruling out the bifocal and standard progressive; the trifocal's limit is 8.00) |
| Sphere 3.00, cylinder 5.00, add 1.50, fitting height 15 mm | Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses and Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses (cylinder above 4.00; fitting height of 15 mm meets their 15 and 14 mm minimums) |
| Sphere minus 13.50, cylinder 1.00, add 2.00, fitting height 16 mm | Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses only |
